question: Find area of a parallelogram with base 9 and height 4.
A parallelogram has area 72 and base 12. Find height.
Base is 10, slanted side 13, perpendicular height 8. Find area.
A parallelogram has area 60 square centimeters and base 7.5 centimeters. Find its height.
solution: Height is 60 divided by 7.5, or 8 centimeters.
